title: 第4937章 百万年无敌的宗门在叶炎面前只能如此了吗第4936章 斩杀帝主
content_zh:
“杀帝主？”
“这？”
此时，当这一幕落在众人眼瞳之下之时，无数修炼者惊颤。
尤其是一些老辈存在，更是叹然到了极致。
“那可是帝主！”
“百万年不败之人。”
“甚至更是在每个时代都出现，每个时代都不死之人。”
其他的存在，甚至还有自上古时代踏出，但这些人是一直都在沉寂。
可帝主呢？
每个时代都出现。
而他已如此境界。
几人能将其尘封？
宛如大帝一般，无法尘封自我，岁月可加身。
但，帝主却可做到比肩天帝之力，让岁月不加身，每个时代都踏出帝宫，行走世间。
而如此存在，叶炎……要斩？
嘶！
仅此瞬间，便让无数修炼者倒吸一口凉气。
“他……这是真的要成为万古第一人？”
一时间，诸多老辈修炼者也是叹然一声。
轰！

而在众人这般感慨之时，一道道轰鸣声顿时间响彻在了此地，不少修炼者目光凝聚，看向远处一方，愕然到了极致。
“叶炎，来了！”
嘶！
当这话语落下，无数的修炼者哗然，所有人全都是看向了叶炎，内心充斥着万道震颤。
“他还真的来了。”
“不怕死吗？”
此刻，太多老辈存在凝神。
咚！
而在他们话语至此之时，苍穹之上，叶炎再度踏出一步，如今距离帝宫愈发近了。
“他……”
帝宫之内，太多修炼者凝神，如今的他们已是严阵以待，全都是看向了叶炎，眸子内也充斥着凝重。
他们也没想到，叶炎竟真的至此。
轰！
但，就在他们话语还没落下之时，叶炎瞬间而至，已然来到了帝宫的上方。
“这是？”
咕咚！
当看到这一幕，很多人侧目，帝宫的这些修炼者也是讶然。
叶炎，一步入帝宫上方苍穹之地，而后，瞬间落下，直接冲向帝宫所在。
嗡！
不过，就在叶炎将要落入帝宫山巅广场之地时，上方一道道光泽闪烁，这乃是一道道屏障。

此屏障宛如能量罩一般，罩住了整个帝宫。
不过，对于这一切，叶炎并不意外。
content_en:
"Kill the emperor?"
"This?"
At this time, when this scene fell in front of everyone's eyes, countless cultivators trembled.
Especially some of the elders were even more shocked to the extreme.
"That's the Emperor!"
"The man who is undefeated for a million years."
"There are even people who appear in every era and are immortal in every era."
There are other existences that have even stepped out from ancient times, but these people have always been silent.
But what about the emperor?
Appears in every era.
And he has reached such a state.
How many people can seal it away?
Like an emperor, he cannot be sealed away in dust, and time can add to his body.
However, the Emperor can match the power of the Emperor of Heaven and let the years pass by. He steps out of the imperial palace and walks around the world in every era.
And with such an existence, Ye Yan... wants to kill him?
hiss!
This moment alone caused countless practitioners to take a breath of cold air.
"He...does he really want to become the number one person in eternity?"
For a time, many older cultivators also sighed.
boom!
And when everyone was feeling this way, a series of roars suddenly resounded throughout the place. Many cultivators focused their eyes and looked to the distance, extremely shocked.
"Ye Yan, here we come!"
Hiss!
When these words fell, countless cultivators were in an uproar. Everyone looked at Ye Yan, and their hearts were filled with thousands of tremors.
"He's really here."
"Aren't you afraid of death?"
At this moment, too many elders are paying attention.
Boom!
And when they were talking, above the sky, Ye Yan took another step, and now he was getting closer to the imperial palace.
"He..."
In the imperial palace, too many cultivators were concentrating. Now they were ready, and they all looked at Ye Yan, their eyes filled with solemnity.
They didn't expect that Ye Yan would actually reach this point.
boom!
However, before they could finish their words, Ye Yan arrived in an instant and was already above the imperial palace.
"This is it?"
Gudong!
When seeing this scene, many people looked sideways, and the practitioners in the Imperial Palace were also surprised.
Ye Yan stepped into the sky above the imperial palace, and then fell down instantly, rushing directly towards the imperial palace.
Buzz!
However, just when Ye Yan was about to fall into the square on the top of the imperial palace, the lights above flashed, which were barriers.
This barrier is like an energy shield, covering the entire imperial palace.
However, Ye Yan was not surprised by all this.
